name: AI Automation Agency Builder
headline: AI Automation Agency Builder: Launch Your AI Agency
short_description: This skill enables users to create a profitable, one-person AI automation agency by leveraging no-code AI tools. It guides users in identifying lucrative niches, constructing AI systems for businesses, and effectively using cold outreach techniques to acquire clients.
author: shyft-ai

sections.overview:
The AI Automation Agency Builder skill empowers users to establish a profitable, one-person AI automation agency by utilizing no-code AI tools. This skill provides a structured approach to identifying lucrative niches and constructing tailored AI systems for businesses. Furthermore, it equips users with effective cold outreach techniques to attract and retain clients, streamlining the entire process of starting an agency from scratch. One of the key benefits of this skill is its focus on practical implementation, allowing users to set up their agency in as little as one hour. By leveraging no-code tools, users can save significant time compared to traditional coding methods, making it accessible even to those with limited technical backgrounds. The skill is particularly beneficial for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners looking to diversify their income streams or automate their existing workflows. Ideal for individuals in roles such as freelance developers or product managers, this skill offers practical use cases, including establishing a one-person AI automation agency, creating and selling AI systems to local businesses, and automating client outreach and interaction using AI tools. For example, a developer could use this skill to build a chatbot for a local restaurant, enhancing customer engagement while generating revenue. With a beginner difficulty level, the AI Automation Agency Builder requires minimal setup and no prior experience in AI development. This skill seamlessly integrates into AI-first workflows, enabling users to harness the power of AI automation efficiently. By adopting this skill, users can position themselves at the forefront of the growing AI automation market, making it a valuable addition to any AI practitioner’s toolkit.
Establishing a one-person AI automation agency
Creating and selling AI systems to local businesses
Automating client outreach and interaction using AI tools
sections.setup: No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
sections.usage:
```
To start your AI automation agency, follow these steps: 
1. Define your financial goal (e.g., $10,000/month).
2. Choose one AI system to offer from the list: [SPEED_TO_LEAD_SYSTEM | AI_BOOKING_SYSTEM | SOCIAL_MEDIA_DM_BOT | AI_RECEPTIONIST].
3. Identify your target industry (e.g., [HVAC_COMPANIES | ROOFERS | PLUMBERS | HOME_CLEANERS]).
4. Design a cold email campaign template focusing on the benefits of your chosen AI solution for [TARGET_INDUSTRY]. Draft a sample subject line and email body using AI. 
5. Use AI tools like Apollo.io to automate the outreach process.
6. Monitor responses to determine the best performing niche and system.

Use this template for cold email:
Subject: Revolutionize Your [TARGET_INDUSTRY] Operations with AI!
Body: Hello [CLIENT_NAME],
I specialize in helping [TARGET_INDUSTRY] like yours increase efficiency and connect with more clients using AI. Our [CHOSEN_AI_SYSTEM] can [BENEFIT_A | BENEFIT_B]. Let’s chat about how we can bring these benefits to your business.
[YOUR_NAME]
```
Copy

```
Email Subject: 'Revolutionize Your Plumbing Operations with AI!'
Email Body: 'Hello Mike,
I specialize in helping plumbing businesses like yours increase efficiency and connect with more clients using AI. Our AI Receptionist can handle calls and service bookings 24/7. Let’s chat about how we can bring these benefits to your business.
Best, Liam'
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf
